title: Parallax
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about layers that go by at different speeds. The screen never scrolls: the far hills, a town and a fence are rows of blocks that slide, each at its own pace, and in the second level clouds drift over the hills while three suns fill in to open a door. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how fast a band goes.

box.tagline: Far is slow. Near is fast.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a path in front of a countryside that never stops going by. Far hills creep, a town drifts, a fence races past, and clouds float over it all. Every layer is a row of blocks that slides at its own pace. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change the speeds.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Layers that slide at their own speeds on a screen that never scrolls
Each layer is a ring of pictures that comes round with no seam
Made to be copied and taken apart
